meta.title: Jonathan Football Coaching — Alachua County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Gainesville, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Jonathan
about.bio: I have over 10 years experience as a certified strength coach with time spent working with youth athletes as young as 6, to working full time with pro athletes. I get athletes of all ages stronger, faster, AND improve their mobility. I truly love getting athletes from Point A to Point B, and I know the most efficient and safest route to get them there.

hero.headline: Alachua County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Jonathan changed the way I see the game. I went from second-string to starter in one season.
testimonials.name: Marcus T.

testimonials.quote: My son has trained with Coach Jonathan for two years. The improvement is night and day.
testimonials.name: Patricia L.
